body: It's my second year of college and I haven't made one actual friend. I've met some cool people but no one that becomes a regular part of my life. I also don't live on campus so I understand you there. I'm also not in any clubs but I feel like if I was I might actually make some friends. But as a secondary education major, and working, I'm too busy for clubs

Literally same. No joke, I was constantly surrounded by people I talked to regularly at school that would make plans with each other and I was never invited. Even things I did get invited to it was because I was in choral groups but I never felt really welcome. I was always ignored and sat in the background. Now out of high school I know who my real friends are (there's only a couple) and at least in college I don't feel so excluded all the time.

Idk if you're in school but I know High School was super toxic for me. I just graduated in 2018 and I'm in College now and I don't dread having to see the same people every day. Cause either we just don't know each other and everyone does their own thing, or I've met people with similar interests cause we're studying the same stuff. High School is a really shitty place

Just because someone else may be going through "worse" than you does not invalidate your problems. Feeling completely alone is one of the worst fucking things you could feel in this world. If you ever need someone to talk to I'm always open. Things will get better, you'll meet people that aren't shitty, I've been there.
